description: Find playable references for product launches, demos, teasers and motion design from Serena Tan's curated video collection.

interface.defaultPrompt: Find launch-video references for my product and help me remake one.
interface.longDescription: Find real launch videos, product demos and teasers for your next release. Explore Serena Tan's curated collection by brand, product, style or aspect ratio, watch playable references and borrow pacing, transitions and vibe for your own product. Creation uses your existing tools; optional task reports and explicit feedback help improve the collection.
